rca_of_the_issue:
In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.jsx the developer wired UI + click handlers but forgot to include two helpers referenced inside the functions:
  • downloadTemplate() uses `TEMPLATE_HEADERS` (line 111) — likely intended to be a module-scope const array of column header strings
  • processFile() calls `normalizeRow(raw)` (line 135) — likely intended to be a module-scope helper that coerces xlsx-parsed row objects into the /events POST payload shape
Both need to be declared at module scope alongside the existing CATEGORIES/CITIES/MODES/emptyEvent constants. Reproduction: log in to /admin, click 'Template' button → red overlay 'TEMPLATE_HEADERS is not defined'; or upload any .csv/.xlsx → toast 'Could not read that file' + console 'normalizeRow is not defined'. Mitigation: add both symbols; keep normalizeRow tolerant of missing/blank cells and boolean-like strings ('TRUE'/'FALSE'/'true'/'false'/'yes'/'no'/1/0).
